text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — p99 streaming latency > 30s for tenant PrimeWave (us-west-2). Trigger: streaming-stall-alerts > 30s. Investigate and mitigate.
Maria Chen: I'm oncall, grabbing traces + logs now. assigning self.
Kevin Patel: I can help with routing/rollbacks. seeing p95 ~1.2s, p99 ~32s across streaming endpoints.
Ian Brooks: Confirming this is single-tenant traffic spike from PrimeWave - heavy fanout from a batch job hitting ~250 concurrent streams.
Zoe Park: CS flagged customer errors and timeouts; they've seen multiple user complaints. pinged PrimeWave.
Maria Chen: Running quick checks — looking at per-prefix token lengths and kv-cache hit ratio for that tenant.
Maria Chen: Command: ```kubectl -n prod logs deploy/streamer-primewave --since=15m | grep -i 'stall\|kvcache' | tail -n 50```
Maria Chen: Logs show repeated "kvcache-miss" during long-prefix streaming and periodic chunk timeouts. sample: `streamer: stall at chunk#12, kvcache-miss, latency=31045ms`
Kevin Patel: Hypothesis: unusually long repeated system prompts + high concurrency -> KV cache thrash -> streaming stalls while kernel waits on kv-pop.
Alex Gomez: I'm going to clear tenant KV and route a small percentage to a fallback model to reduce load.
Alex Gomez: Running clear: ```curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://internal.api/tenants/primewave/actions/clear_kv```
Alex Gomez: Response: `{ "status": "ok", "evicted_keys": 1282 }`
deploy-bot: Deploybot: Performed canary routing: 10% traffic -> rw-v0-small-quantized for tenant primewave, started at 10:03 UTC.
Maria Chen: Throttling concurrency for tenant to 4 streams per connection, applying soft rate-limit 100r/s via per-tenant policy. Command: `rwctl set-rate primewave 100`
Kevin Patel: Temporarily disabling streaming for PrimeWave while we validate fallback quality. Serving non-streaming chunked responses as fallback.
Maria Chen: Metric snapshot: before mitigation p99=32.4s, p95=1.18s. After clear+throttle+fallback (10m): p99 dropped to ~3.8s, p95 ~0.9s.
Ian Brooks: Captured traces: trace-ppw-abc123, trace-ppw-def456. Those show wait on kv-pop and request queuing on the worker.
Zoe Park: CS update sent to PrimeWave: brief explaining mitigations (reduced concurrency, routed to fallback, disabled streaming), advising to throttle client-side retries.
cs-team: Customer acknowledged, asked for timeline and root cause. We've offered a postmortem and dedicated follow-up call.
Maria Chen: Temporary remediation plan: 1) keep throttles & fallback for 30m, 2) collect full traces and token-length histogram, 3) run eviction policy tweaks in staging, 4) follow up with engineering fix.
Kevin Patel: Action items created: IN-41277 (investigate kv-cache eviction thresholds & routing), IN-41278 (alert tuning for streaming stalls p99), IN-41279 (add per-tenant prefix-length anomaly detector).
Alex Gomez: Will run a controlled repro in staging using recorded PrimeWave traffic (sanitized) to validate eviction policy and model fallbacks.
Maria Chen: On-call handoff: I'm handing to Kevin at 10:20 UTC. Kevin, please monitor p99 for next 2 hours and coordinate rollout of hotfix if repro succeeds.
Kevin Patel: Ack, taking over. I'll keep throttles until we verify changes.
Ian Brooks: Quick note: observed a correlated increase in memory pressure on media-gpu nodes at peak. Could be amplification under high concurrent streaming.
Maria Chen: Added SRE runbook updates for streaming stall checklist and clearer paging thresholds.
deploy-bot: Incident channel updated: incident created IN-41276, severity P2, impacted tenant: PrimeWave.
Zoe Park: CS will schedule a follow-up call for tomorrow EOD.
Maria Chen: Final: mitigation stable, customer notified, follow-ups created. Marking thread for incident report draft. :thumbsup:
Kevin Patel: Will post incident timeline and preliminary root cause in the ticket after I collect final traces.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Pager resolved for now; alerts suppressed for the tenant until manual clear. Remember to run post-incident eval and add any missing dashboards.
